observations.body: The signed-out employee portal shows Username and Password fields and a Sign in button.
The signed-out form is ready with the Employee username and configured password to submit.
Submitting Employee credentials opened the authenticated dashboard with navigation and quick actions.
Sign in reached Dashboard.
Dashboard shows navigation to Directory, My Leave, Timesheet and My Profile, plus Request leave, Fill timesheet and Log out controls.
Selecting Timesheet from authenticated navigation opened the employee timesheet for the week of Sep 14, 2026.
Timesheet shows a draft for week of Sep 14, 2026 with Monday through Sunday hour inputs all at 0, total 0 h, and Save draft and Submit week buttons.
The Sep 14, 2026 draft has 8 hours entered for Monday, 0 on other days, and total 8 h; it is evaluation data.
Save draft kept the Sep 14, 2026 timesheet at 8 total hours and displayed “Draft saved.” The saved hours are evaluation data.
